name: What happens during the professional cabinet installation process?

mainEntity.name: What happens during the professional cabinet installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet installation requires multiple stages to ensure structural integrity and a clean finish. First, the old cabinetry is carefully removed and walls are inspected for plumbing, electrical, or drywall repairs. Next, the installer finds the high point of the floor and marks level reference lines along wall studs. Upper cabinets are mounted first, anchored into structural framing. Base cabinets are then set, leveled with shims, and fastened together. Finally, doors are aligned, decorative molding is installed, and hardware is attached.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installers tear out old units, find level reference lines, secure upper and lower boxes to wall studs, shim for plumb, and attach doors, trim, and hardware.
